question_cn: 拦截（Interference）战术的核心机制是什么？
question_en: What is the core mechanism of the interference tactic?

options.text_cn: 移走己方棋子，暴露其身后另一个棋子的攻击线
options.text_en: Move one of your own pieces to uncover an attack by a piece behind it

options.text_cn: 将己方一个棋子插入对方两子之间的联系线上，破坏它们的协同防守
options.text_en: Place one of your pieces on the line between two opposing pieces to disrupt their defensive coordination

options.text_cn: 牺牲棋子把对方强力子引到不利位置，再实施叉击或将杀
options.text_en: Sacrifice a piece to lure a powerful opposing piece to an unfavorable square, then fork or checkmate it

options.text_cn: 攻击对方的保护者，使目标棋子失去防护后直接吃掉
options.text_en: Attack a defender so its target loses protection and can be captured

explanation_cn: 拦截的本质是「断联」：把己方棋子强行插入对方两个协作子之间的横线、纵线或斜线，让它们无法相互支援。本题黑马Nd3+插入d列，精确切断Qd6与Rd1的联系，强迫Rxd3，白车离开d列，黑方得势。
explanation_en: Interference breaks a connection: force one of your pieces onto a rank, file, or diagonal between two cooperating enemy pieces so they can no longer support each other. Here, Black's knight plays Nd3+, cutting the d-file connection between Qd6 and Rd1 and forcing Rxd3, which draws the white rook away from the file and gives Black the advantage.
